description: CREATE FUNCTION ... LANGUAGE JAVA with the handler class written INLINE between dollar quotes, then called from SQL. Pinned across the shapes a scalar Java UDF is used in: no arguments, a STRING argument, an INTEGER argument, several arguments at once, a BOOLEAN return driving a WHERE clause, a two-argument call in a SELECT list over a table, a handler with real control flow (an iterative factorial), a handler returning null so the SQL value is NULL, two independent functions selected side by side, and a Java UDF nested inside a built-in (UPPER). Converted 1:1 from udf/InlineJavaFunctionTest (now retired), a JDBC test whose statements are all plain SQL.
